verses.text: O come, let us sing for joy to the LORD, Let us shout joyfully to the rock of our salvation.
verses.textZh: 來啊，我們要向耶和華歌唱，向拯救我們的磐石歡呼！

verses.text: Let us come before His presence with thanksgiving, Let us shout joyfully to Him with psalms.
verses.textZh: 我們要來感謝他，用詩歌向他歡呼！

verses.text: For the LORD is a great God And a great King above all gods,
verses.textZh: 因耶和華為大神，為大王，超乎萬神之上。

verses.text: In whose hand are the depths of the earth, The peaks of the mountains are His also.
verses.textZh: 地的深處在他手中；山的高峰也屬他。

verses.text: The sea is His, for it was He who made it, And His hands formed the dry land.
verses.textZh: 海洋屬他，是他造的；旱地也是他手造成的。

verses.text: Come, let us worship and bow down, Let us kneel before the LORD our Maker.
verses.textZh: 來啊，我們要屈身敬拜，在造我們的耶和華面前跪下。

verses.text: For He is our God, And we are the people of His pasture and the sheep of His hand. Today, if you would hear His voice,
verses.textZh: 因為他是我們的神；我們是他草場的羊，是他手下的民。惟願你們今天聽他的話：

verses.text: Do not harden your hearts, as at Meribah, As in the day of Massah in the wilderness,
verses.textZh: 你們不可硬著心，像當日在米利巴，就是在曠野的瑪撒。

verses.text: 'When your fathers tested Me, They tried Me, though they had seen My work.
verses.textZh: 那時，你們的祖宗試我探我，並且觀看我的作為。

verses.text: 'For forty years I loathed [that] generation, And said they are a people who err in their heart, And they do not know My ways.
verses.textZh: 四十年之久，我厭煩那世代，說：這是心裡迷糊的百姓，竟不曉得我的作為！

verses.text: 'Therefore I swore in My anger, Truly they shall not enter into My rest.'
verses.textZh: 所以，我在怒中起誓，說：他們斷不可進入我的安息！
